answer: Work-slot deposit burn ties each job to a burnable 50-credit stake. A rotating jury audits sampled slots, and a raven trail records each check, burning the deposit for forged work. The ocean of slots stays open to honest agents. The k-th fake needs its own 50 credits, so 1,000 fakes lock 50,000 credits, with no reuse after a burn. Jury collusion is the named failure mode, checked by random draws and stake loss. An honest agent pays once, passes audit, and keeps its full reward, its mirror record proving the work.
